messages:
Maya: Heads up — ApexPay flagged a big mismatch during month-close. Dashboard report shows ~1,205,987 tokens for March but the generated invoice inv_2025-03-apex totals 950,321 and they got moved down a tier. Escalating to billing ops and infra. /cc @Luca @Raj @Connor
Luca: Got it. Can you paste the acct id + invoice link so we can pull ledger entries?
Maya: acct_apex_001. Invoice: https://billing.redwood/internal/invoices/inv_2025-03-apex. Dashboard report: https://dash.redwood/internal/reports/account/acct_apex_001?range=2025-03-01_2025-04-01
BillingBot: invoice_generated acct_apex_001 inv_2025-03-apex generated=2025-04-01T00:02:12Z total_tokens=950321
Raj: Quick Q — is the UI pulling numbers from ui_aggregates or directly from ledger? We've seen UI cache/agg jobs include retries pre-dedup sometimes. Can you upload the dashboard CSV (or paste header+totals)?
Maya: Uploaded CSV to /files/apex_march_dashboard.csv. Preview pasted below:
```
date,gen_tokens,embed_tokens,total_tokens
2025-03-01,1200,300,1500
2025-03-02,14560,2300,16860
...
TOTAL,, ,1205987
```
Raj: Hmm. That TOTAL matches what ApexPay sees. Connor — did any ingestion/backfill jobs hit the ledger around cutoff?
Connor: I see embed_backfill_v2 ran 2025-03-31T23:50:12Z and there was a replay (queued) at 2025-04-01T00:05:34Z. Logs indicate some records had missing idempotency keys so the backfill appended duplicates to raw_events, but Billing's invoice run deduped by invoice logic. I'll open the ingestion trace. :thinking:
Luca: If ledger deduped at billing time but UI aggregates are summing raw_events or a stale cache, that explains the 1.2M vs 950k. We need to confirm where UI aggregates read from and whether cache was refreshed post-backfill.
Raj: Can one of you run this quick ledger sanity query and paste totals?
```sql
SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM ledger.events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_apex_001'
  AND event_time >= '2025-03-01'
  AND event_time < '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY source;
```
Connor: Ran it — result shows ledger_sum=950321 (matches invoice). Raw_events table has ~1.2M when including duplicates.
Maya: Confirmed: ledger matches invoice (950,321). Dashboard CSV is pulling from ui_aggregates which still has duplicates. Looks like UI aggregation job didn't apply dedup window for that backfill.
Connor: Filing INF-4523 for aggregation dedup fix and a one-off cache refresh for acct_apex_001. ETA for cache refresh: ~6 hours. Will include repro steps and the faulty backfill job id.
Luca: I'll hold any billing adjustments until we complete the cache refresh and re-run dashboard export. If ApexPay requests immediate credit, we'll coordinate manual note but invoice stands until we reconcile.
Raj: For RCA notes: root cause looks like backfill replay without idempotency keys + ui_aggregates not deduping backfill records. Action items: Connor to patch aggregation (INF-4523), SRE to refresh cache for affected accounts, Billing to validate invoice vs ledger before auto-tiering.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll update ApexPay with interim status: investigating; ledger/invoice correct; UI numbers overcount due to backfill; we'll follow up with corrected dashboard and timeline. :thumbsup:
